from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialStatementRow(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by the report (e.g. '2022', '2023')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific financial line item description (e.g. 'Non-current assets')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency or scale unit (e.g. 'USD', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_statement_rows: list[FinancialStatementRow]
